title: Tightened slack constants on the conservative paired scratch-reuse candidate: conditional κ = 3.6210858481e-4
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Extends PR #135's draft candidate (this branch's parent, same status) by one instantiation choice: the retained 47-constraint assembly is instantiated with beta = 10^-15 and backoff = 10^-17 instead of the legacy beta = 10^-6, backoff = 10^-14 that PR #135 inherits from the PR104-era lineage (#97 used beta = 1/4, the batched assembly 1/1000, #104 10^-6, machinery unchanged; the strict constraints involve beta only through positivity and leaf-ordering margins, checked at exact rationals; the complex side binds, so the assembly bit saving is exactly (1-beta)*ac - backoff).

Everything else is byte-identical to PR #135: the pinned PR131 physical word with 26,597 roles and 2,108 compensated birth-cut aliases, PR132's orthogonal first-stage lockstep pairing, the conservative data-wire moment penalty, the stopped bit supplier, the finite bridge, all routers, reserves and charges.

Result, under all of PR #135's retained hypotheses (shared-scratch execution theorem and inherited all-size analytic/tape contracts remain assumptions):

kappa = 362108584810/10^15 = 3.62108584810e-4,

361,856 grid points (denominator 10^15) above PR #135's 3.62108222954e-4, the furthest published value at submission. This is a finite arithmetic candidate exactly in PR #135's status; no new physical execution is claimed and no global optimality is claimed. This is an instantiation refinement in the genre of #61, #100 and #107.

## Validation

`research/tightened-slack/certificate-tight.py` re-runs PR #135's own certificate chain end to end from its pinned inputs (SHA-256 pins in SOURCE.json) at the refined constants: stopped bit supplier reproduction, finite bridge with reflection-audit charge checks, paired histogram telescoping identity, exact rational log/exp moment penalty enclosures, kappa bracket with next-10^-15-grid-point rejection, the +3%-over-PR132 target check, and all 47 strict constraints and 7 margins. Result is printed as PASS with kappa = 36210858481/100000000000000 (exact fraction 362108584810/10^15); the next grid point is rejected by the chain's own check. All construction credit belongs to the inherited lineage as recorded in NOTICE/SOURCES: PR131's physical word, PR130's three-stage cover, PR132's lockstep pairing, and PR #135's combination (DanieleCorso).


---

Note: this branch is one commit carrying PR #135's draft tree plus the tightened instantiation, so the certificate is runnable from this branch alone. `.github/` is left at base-`main`'s state, so PR #135's auxiliary CI workflow file is not carried here; no CI changes are proposed.
